neighborhoods.name: Highland
neighborhoods.homes: historic houses, some split into apartments

housing: Shreveport's rentals are mostly older single-family houses and apartment complexes, with historic houses in Highland and South Highlands.
climate: Test the air conditioning and look for termite damage, foundation cracks and mold; summers are hot and humid.
fact: Louisiana leases are governed by the state Civil Code, which follows civil law rather than the common law used in other states.
